title: C11 Partly remembered, could not look it up, and verified nothing there
capability: Three situations that must not collapse into one sentence. A date that was fully read and holds nothing may be called empty. A range that was only partly reachable must be answered as partial. A lookup that failed must be owned as not being able to recall right now. 'We never talked about that' and 'that was the first time' are claims that need a verified, complete read of the relevant range. None of this is said in system vocabulary.

allowed.statement: Nothing was said on Friday 11 September; the neighbouring days hold a printmaking evening class on the Thursday and a first test print on the Saturday.
In late August the person gave up a small rented painting studio after three years and stored the easel and leftover paints on a sister's balcony.

forbidden.statement: Saying nothing was discussed in late August, or that there is no record of it.
Naming the evening class on 10 September as the first mention of anything to do with art.
Mentioning windows, context, retrieval, databases, limits or similar mechanisms as the reason.
Supplying content for the Friday on which nothing was said.

time.statement: The earliest mention of art in the retained history is 25 August, when the studio was given up.

expectedBehavior: Friday: say plainly that nothing was said that day, optionally offering the days either side.
Late August: retell the studio, or, if only part can be reached, say which part is remembered and that the rest is hazy.
First mention: 25 August, and only after the earlier range has actually been checked.
If a lookup fails: say it cannot be recalled right now, without blaming a mechanism and without claiming there is nothing.
failureSignals: 'No record' is claimed for a range that was never read.
A within-window date is given as the first mention.
All three situations get the same 'we have not talked about that' reply.

criteria.description: The first question streams and commits.
The asked-about Friday is covered by a complete, unbounded read that found nothing.
The days either side of the empty Friday reach the Provider.
The late-August date that was asked about is covered by a recorded read, so a statement about it can be verified.
The late-August messages reach the Provider when that range is asked about.
The true earliest mention reaches the Provider before 'the first time' is answered.
A failed history read is distinguished from an empty one.

check.capability: inject a history read failure or a partial read for a single turn

criteria.description: The verified empty day is called empty, naturally, with nothing invented.
The older range is retold or honestly described as partly remembered, never denied.
'The first time' is only claimed for the true earliest mention.
